text: lee: Quick sync — I sketched a draft plan for the benchmark blog + webinar hook comparing Redwood inference economics and latency stability vs major cloud LLM endpoints. Need fast alignment on claims we can prove and the battlecard lines. maria: Who's the primary audience for the webinar and blog? engineers or execs? lee: Primary = platform + infra engineers at mid-market / enterprise, secondary = product leads evaluating inferencing options. CTA = webinar sign-up + limited eval credits for Dedicated. jordan: Ok — big ask: any vendor name-specific claims need legal sign-off. We should avoid direct brand callouts unless we've run tests in their published configs. maria: Understood. For messaging, we can use "major cloud endpoints" phrasing and a single table with anonymized vendor labels. sam: From the perf team: quick numbers from last week's steady-state runs — p50 roughly same, p99 improved 3-6x with batching + prefix caching on Dedicated; cost per 1M tokens ~40% lower for long-context workloads. I can drop the raw CSV and summary. alex: I can turn sam's numbers into 2 visuals: latency CDF and cost normalized per 1M tokens, and a 90s demo clip showing model fallback to a smaller variant under queue pressure. devops-bot: load-test finished: steady 50k tokens/s sustained for 30m; artifacts: s3://redwood-marketing/bench/1768004321/logs (access perms: marketing-read). jordan: Good — alex/maria please redact any infra-level configs from public artifacts. Also, flag any test configs that mirror partner-managed regions. maria: Proposed bite-sized battlecard lines: - "Predictable p99 under steady throughput" - "Transparent per-route cost breakdowns vs opaque per-invocation bills" - "Built-in fallbacks and model variants to keep experiences online" Keep it short for SDRs. lee: Nice. Action items: @alex produce visuals + 90s demo by EOD tomorrow; @sam publish perf summary + raw CSV link; @maria draft battlecard + 3 social launch posts (short + long variants); @jordan loop in legal for vendor-phrasing approval; i'll schedule a 30m review on Thursday 10am PT. maria: Will do. :thumbsup: sam: I'll push PR perf/bench/1768004321 and add CSV to the s3 path devops-bot mentioned. jordan: I'll ping legal and share suggested wording in a separate doc. lee: Thanks team — let's keep claims tight and reproducible. We'll gate public blog on legal sign-off and the perf PR being merged.
